Container.Name: nzblab-agent
Container.Overview:
Read-only NAS monitor for the NASlab Android app (NASlab Agent, formerly NZBLab-Agent). Measures around the clock every 30 seconds: all temperature sensors, CPU load (total and per core), GPU (render and media engine used by Plex transcoding), RAM, network, disk spin-ups after idle (and which programs woke them), top processes, cache usage per share and a file index for searching all shares. Keeps 8 days at full resolution and 2 years of hourly values in /config. It never changes anything on your server: every host path is mounted read-only, only /config is writable, and the container drops root privileges (PUID/PGID).
Since 1.15.0 it also records restarts, the temperature of every disk, router/internet latency and RAID/pool state. Optional and off by default: SMART values (NZBLAB_SMART), backup discovery for extra paths (NZBLAB_BACKUP_PATHS) and redacted log excerpts (NZBLAB_LOGS). The agent never updates itself: use "Update" on the Docker page.
Since 1.16.0 the app can connect your services in one step: the agent finds Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, SABnzbd, Tautulli and Overseerr/Jellyseerr in appdata (read-only) and passes their API keys to the app over the token-protected API. Plex tokens are never read. Turn it off with DISCOVER_KEYS=0.
After the first start, open the container log: it shows "NZBLab-Agent Token: ..." once. Paste this token into the app (Settings > Server connections > NASlab-Agent). The token is also stored in appdata/nzblab-agent/token.txt. A read-only dashboard is available in the browser on port 8099. Do not expose this port to the internet; use a VPN (WireGuard, Tailscale) when away from home.
Deutsch: Misst Temperaturen, CPU, Grafikchip, RAM und Plattenzugriffe rund um die Uhr für die NASlab-App (NASlab-Agent, früher NZBLab-Agent). Nur lesen, ändert nichts am NAS. Den Token zeigt das Container-Log beim ersten Start («NZBLab-Agent Token: …»), danach steht er in appdata/nzblab-agent/token.txt.
Container.Requires: The NASlab Android app. Unraid 6.12 or newer.

Config.Name: Web/API port
Config.Description: Port for the app and the browser dashboard

Config.Name: Data (/config)
Config.Description: Required, read/write. The agent stores its token and history here; without it you get a new token after every update. History (SQLite), file index, settings and token.txt. The only writable path.

Config.Name: Shares (file index)
Config.Description: Read-only. Search across all shares, storage analysis, duplicates, media inventory, appdata sizes. appdata, system, domains and isos are skipped by the index.

Config.Name: Cache pool
Config.Description: Read-only. What is waiting for the mover, per share. Remove this path if you have no pool named 'cache' (more pools: variable CACHE_ROOTS).

Config.Name: Host /sys
Config.Description: Read-only. Temperature sensors and GPU.

Config.Name: Host /proc
Config.Description: Read-only. CPU load, top programs, disk activity.

Config.Name: Unraid notifications
Config.Description: Read-only. Unraid notifications for the 'Today' timeline.

Config.Name: System log
Config.Description: Read-only. Errors from syslog for the 'Today' timeline.

Config.Name: Docker container names
Config.Description: Read-only. Container names in the 'top load' list. Needs PUID=0 (the files are readable by root only).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: e.g. Europe/Berlin, America/New_York

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the agent runs as after start (99 = nobody). 0 = root: needed only for container names and appdata folders of other containers with strict permissions.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group (100 = users)

Config.Name: Token (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty: the agent creates a random token on first start (container log and appdata/nzblab-agent/token.txt).

Config.Name: Heat alert (°C)
Config.Description: Push via ntfy when the CPU stays above this for 5 minutes

Config.Name: ntfy URL (optional)
Config.Description: e.g. https://ntfy.sh/a-long-secret-topic for push alerts while away

Config.Name: SMART (optional)
Config.Description: 1 = read SMART values of the disks (model, serial, power-on hours, reallocated/pending sectors, CRC/media errors, wear, temperature). Read-only: smartctl --scan and smartctl -a -n standby only, never self-tests, never writes, sleeping disks stay asleep. Needs the disks as devices and SYS_RAWIO, e.g. Extra Parameters: --cap-add=SYS_RAWIO --device=/dev/sdb (NVMe also --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN). Leave PUID as is: a small root helper only runs smartctl. 0 = off.

Config.Name: Log excerpts (optional)
Config.Description: 1 = the app may show recent error and warning lines from the System log path (/var/log, read-only). IP/MAC/e-mail addresses, tokens, passwords, user names and share paths are removed before anything leaves the agent; it never sends logs anywhere by itself. 0 = off.

Config.Name: Network latency
Config.Description: 1 = every minute, measure the TCP connect time to the router and to 1.1.1.1:443 (no data is sent, no extra rights). Shows in the app whether the router or the internet is slow. 0 = off.

Config.Name: Find services and API keys
Config.Description: 1 = the app can connect Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, SABnzbd, Tautulli and Overseerr/Jellyseerr in one step: the agent reads their API key, port and URL base from the settings files in appdata (Shares path, read-only; no docker.sock). Only with the agent token, at most 10 requests per minute, never logged. Plex tokens are never read; Jellyfin/Emby keys must be created in their web UI. 0 = only list which services exist, without keys.

Config.Name: Backup paths (optional)
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths of backup repositories (restic, borg, kopia) or backup log files (rsync, scripts), e.g. /host/backup. Add each one as an extra read-only path first. Only file names and times are read, never the backup contents. Empty = only search the shares for backup folders.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Address the agent listens on inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 with bridge networking; use the LAN address with host networking, or 127.0.0.1 behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Price country (optional)
Config.Description: Disk prices: CH, DE, AT, US, GB, ... Usually set from the app. Empty = no price lookups.
